arStrings.szText:
For the next {c_number}30{/c} minutes:
{icon:bullet} Increases Lightning, Cold and Poison Resistances by {c_yellow}+7%{/c} for all nearby players.
{icon:bullet} Increases Experience by {c_yellow}5%{/c}.
This is a Resistance Incense. Only one Resistance Incense may be active at a time. Experience Bonus does not stack with other Incenses.
